get_driver_stats_cached.body: DECLARE v_stats driver_stats_cache; BEGIN SELECT * INTO v_stats FROM driver_stats_cache WHERE driver_id = p_driver_id; RETURN v_stats; END;

get_delivery_metrics_cached.body: BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM delivery_metrics_cache WHERE delivery_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date ORDER BY delivery_date DESC; END;

get_hourly_metrics_cached.body: BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM hourly_metrics_cache WHERE hour >= NOW() - (p_hours_ago || ' hours')::INTERVAL ORDER BY hour DESC; END;

trigger_bitrix24_sync.body: DECLARE sync_record RECORD; BEGIN IF OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN SELECT * INTO sync_record FROM bitrix24_sync WHERE order_id = NEW.id LIMIT 1; IF sync_record IS NOT NULL OR NEW.bitrix24_deal_id IS NOT NULL THEN INSERT INTO bitrix24_sync (order_id, deal_id, sync_status, last_synced_at) VALUES ( NEW.id, COALESCE(sync_record.deal_id, NEW.bitrix24_deal_id), 'pending', now() ) ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO UPDATE SET sync_status = 'pending', last_synced_at = now(); END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END;

cleanup_old_system_logs.body: BEGIN DELETE FROM system_logs WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'; END;

create_audit_log.body: BEGIN INSERT INTO audit_log ( user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, changes ) VALUES ( auth.uid(), p_action, p_resource_type, p_resource_id, p_changes ); END;

audit_driver_changes.body: BEGIN PERFORM create_audit_log( 'driver.update', 'driver', NEW.id, jsonb_build_object('before', to_jsonb(OLD), 'after', to_jsonb(NEW)) ); RETURN NEW; END;

update_job_queue_updated_at.body: BEGIN NEW.updated_at = NOW(); RETURN NEW; END;

add_job.args: p_type TEXT, p_payload JSONB, p_priority INTEGER DEFAULT 5, p_max_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 3, p_metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
add_job.body: DECLARE v_job_id UUID; BEGIN IF p_type NOT IN ('webhook', 'notification', 'evaluation', 'bitrix_sync', 'email', 'whatsapp', 'slack') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid job type: %', p_type; END IF; IF p_priority < 1 OR p_priority > 10 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Priority must be between 1 and 10'; END IF; INSERT INTO job_queue ( type, payload, priority, max_attempts, metadata, created_by ) VALUES ( p_type, p_payload, p_priority, p_max_attempts, p_metadata, auth.uid() ) RETURNING id INTO v_job_id; RAISE NOTICE 'Job added: % (type: %, priority: %)', v_job_id, p_type, p_priority; RETURN v_job_id; END;

get_next_jobs.args: p_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 10, p_types TEXT[] DEFAULT NULL
get_next_jobs.body: BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM job_queue WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) AND (p_types IS NULL OR type = ANY(p_types)) ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC LIMIT p_limit FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; END;

mark_job_processing.body: DECLARE v_updated BOOLEAN; BEGIN UPDATE job_queue SET status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_job_id AND status = 'PENDING' RETURNING TRUE INTO v_updated; RETURN COALESCE(v_updated, FALSE); END;

mark_job_completed.args: p_job_id UUID, p_result JSONB DEFAULT NULL
mark_job_completed.body: BEGIN UPDATE job_queue SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(), metadata = CASE WHEN p_result IS NOT NULL THEN metadata || jsonb_build_object('result', p_result) ELSE metadata END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_job_id AND status = 'PROCESSING'; RETURN FOUND; END;

mark_job_failed.args: p_job_id UUID, p_error_message TEXT, p_error_stack TEXT DEFAULT NULL
mark_job_failed.body: DECLARE v_job RECORD; v_next_retry TIMESTAMPTZ; v_backoff_seconds INTEGER; BEGIN SELECT * INTO v_job FROM job_queue WHERE id = p_job_id AND status IN ('PROCESSING', 'PENDING'); IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF; v_job.attempts := v_job.attempts + 1; IF v_job.attempts >= v_job.max_attempts THEN UPDATE job_queue SET status = 'FAILED', attempts = v_job.attempts, error_message = p_error_message, error_stack = p_error_stack, completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_job_id; RAISE NOTICE 'Job % failed permanently after % attempts', p_job_id, v_job.attempts; ELSE v_backoff_seconds := POWER(2, v_job.attempts)::INTEGER; v_next_retry := NOW() + (v_backoff_seconds || ' seconds')::INTER …

add_job.body: DECLARE v_job_id UUID; BEGIN IF p_type NOT IN ('webhook', 'notification', 'evaluation', 'bitrix_sync', 'email', 'whatsapp', 'slack') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid job type: %', p_type; END IF; IF p_priority < 1 OR p_priority > 10 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Priority must be between 1 and 10'; END IF; INSERT INTO job_queue ( type, payload, priority, max_attempts, metadata, created_by ) VALUES ( p_type, p_payload, p_priority, p_max_attempts, p_metadata, auth.uid() ) RETURNING id INTO v_job_id; RAISE NOTICE 'Job added: % (type: %, priority: %)', v_job_id, p_type, p_priority; RETURN v_job_id; END;

mark_job_processing.body: DECLARE v_updated BOOLEAN; BEGIN UPDATE job_queue SET status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_job_id AND status = 'PENDING' RETURNING TRUE INTO v_updated; RETURN COALESCE(v_updated, FALSE); END;
